description: This file contains unit tests for the AWS SQS streaming subscription scenarios within the Orleans framework. It defines a test class 'SQSSubscriptionMultiplicityTests' that sets up a test cluster, configures SQS stream provider options, and includes multiple test methods to verify parallel, linear, add/remove, resubscription, and client subscription behaviors for SQS streams.

classes.name: SQSSubscriptionMultiplicityTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying various subscription patterns for AWS SQS streams within Orleans. It sets up the test cluster, configures stream providers, and contains test methods for different subscription scenarios.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the Orleans test cluster with SQS stream provider and storage.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and creates a test runner instance.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up resources, including deleting SQS queues used during tests.

methods.name: SQSMultipleParallelSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests multiple parallel subscriptions to SQS streams.

methods.name: SQSMultipleLinearSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests linear (sequential) subscriptions to SQS streams.

methods.name: SQSMultipleSubscriptionTest_AddRemove
methods.description: Tests subscription addition and removal scenarios.

methods.name: SQSResubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests resubscription behavior for SQS streams.

methods.name: SQSSubscribeFromClientTest
methods.description: Tests subscribing to SQS streams from a client.
